VNCCS_UniCanvas_PromptEnhance_Prompts.name: System prompts per model family
VNCCS_UniCanvas_PromptEnhance_Prompts.tooltip: Opens a window with one tab per model family. A family without a system prompt has no wand. The wand, automatic mode and the wand's encoder are in the UniCanvas settings.

VNCCS_UniCanvas_StandaloneSidebar.name: Show the standalone UniCanvas sidebar tab
VNCCS_UniCanvas_StandaloneSidebar.tooltip: Adds a UniCanvas workspace to the ComfyUI sidebar that works without a node or workflow.
